1	export type Cell = [x: number, y: number];
2	
3	const isSameCell = ([x, y]: Cell, [otherX, otherY]: Cell): boolean =>
4	  x === otherX && y === otherY;
5	
6	const neighborsOf = ([x, y]: Cell): Cell[] => [
7	  [x - 1, y - 1],
8	  [x, y - 1],
9	  [x + 1, y - 1],
10	  [x - 1, y],
11	  [x + 1, y],
12	  [x - 1, y + 1],
13	  [x, y + 1],
14	  [x + 1, y + 1],
15	];
16	
17	const isNeighborOf = (cell: Cell, other: Cell): boolean =>
18	  neighborsOf(cell).some((neighbor) => isSameCell(neighbor, other));
19	
20	const countLivingNeighbors = (cell: Cell, livingCells: Cell[]): number =>
21	  livingCells.filter((other) => isNeighborOf(cell, other)).length;
22	
23	const survives = (livingNeighbors: number): boolean =>
24	  livingNeighbors >= 2 && livingNeighbors <= 3;
25	
26	const isBorn = (livingNeighbors: number): boolean => livingNeighbors === 3;
27	
28	const isLiving = (cell: Cell, livingCells: Cell[]): boolean =>
29	  livingCells.some((livingCell) => isSameCell(cell, livingCell));
30	
31	const withoutDuplicates = (cells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
32	  cells.filter(
33	    (cell, index) =>
34	      cells.findIndex((other) => isSameCell(cell, other)) === index,
35	  );
36	
37	const bornCells = (livingCells: Cell[]): Cell[] =>
38	  withoutDuplicates(livingCells.flatMap(neighborsOf)).filter(
39	    (candidate) =>
40	      !isLiving(candidate, livingCells) &&
41	      isBorn(countLivingNeighbors(candidate, livingCells)),
42	  );
43	
44	export const nextGeneration = (livingCells: Cell[]): Cell[] => [
45	  ...livingCells.filter((cell) =>
46	    survives(countLivingNeighbors(cell, livingCells)),
47	  ),
48	  ...bornCells(livingCells),
49	];
